# Unathi
Unathi are a scaled species of reptilian beings from the desert world of Moghes. They are strict carnivores and cannot digest plant matter at all. Raw meat does them no harm whatsoever.
Unathi tolerate [color=#ffa500]far more heat than humans[/color] before they start to cook.
However, the cold is another matter. They begin taking damage [color=#1e90ff]earlier than humans do[/color], take [color=#1e90ff]30% more Cold damage[/color], and slow down noticeably as they chill. a cold-blooded body does not keep itself warm. Being put in a cryo pod will hurt, so medical should use burn medicine or leporazine to compensate.
Unathi eyes gather far more light than a human's, letting them see in the dark where others would be blind.
Their unarmed attacks deal [color=#ffa500]Slash damage instead of Blunt[/color].
A thick, muscular tail lets them drag objects without using their hands, leaving both free for other work.
A Unathi who has drunk welding fuel can belch up a small flame into their own hand, hot enough to light a cigarette.
